title: AE2 Sort Selector
description: Very simple mod that lets you choose AE2 terminal sort options directly.
body:
# AE2 Sort Selector

Very simple mod that lets you choose AE2 terminal sort options directly.  
Nothing else, so if you want fancy terminal tweaks, check out other mods.
